policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Hawaii Hilo's third straight defeat levels their record Hawaii Hilo have not won since their opening matches, and the defeat at MSU Denver is their third in succession. Three wins and three defeats, and not a draw among them, is the record they carry into Pacific West Conference play.
